row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Medbridge offers SAML/OAuth SSO "at no additional charge" and automates users through HR Sync (SFTP CSV files) or a Merge-powered User Management Integration with HRIS and identity providers; no SCIM endpoint appears in its help centre or site.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5): 558 help-centre articles (JSON API) and the site sitemap contain no SCIM. Provisioning paths: (1) User Management Integration (new May 2026, page marked Beta), a backend sync built on Merge that connects 80+ HRIS and identity providers (the page's integration data lists Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud, Google Workspace and shows a Microsoft Entra logo), described as available for all plans, recorded as vendor-run directory_sync; (2) HR Sync, CSV files over SFTP checked hourly, available for purchase or on specific plans. SSO (SAML 2.0 or OAuth) at no extra charge and listed in every plan article, but users must be on the Medbridge roster with SSO IDs; new SSO users are added via a CSV sent to admin support. Pricing per seat per year: Educate Business Essentials $49 (cheapest group plan, Educate tab), In-Home Basics $75, In-Home Essentials $149, Education Essentials $279; bundles Medbridge Essentials $329, Elite $369; 50+ seats via sales. Okta OIN app is SWA only (2018).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented; IdP/HRIS automation runs through Merge (User Management Integration) or SFTP HR Sync. false is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: No public user-management API documentation found on medbridge.com or support.medbridge.com.

okta.notes: OIN app (2018) checks SWA only (read from page markup). Separate from the Merge-based User Management Integration, which lists Okta in its integration data.

entra.notes: No Entra tutorial in saas-apps toc.json; Entra logo appears on the User Management Integration page.

fallbacks.other_sync: User Management Integration via Merge (80+ HRIS and identity providers); HR Sync CSV over SFTP (hourly); EMR integrations (Epic Pathways uses JIT)
fallbacks.notes: jit false: SSO setup requires the full roster loaded with unique IDs, and new SSO users are added by sending a roster CSV to admin support. The Epic Pathways integration has just-in-time provisioning, but that is for clinicians inside Epic, not IdP SSO.
